actions.reason: K5_C0001 has an interpretable biological identity (OXPHOS/metabolic down-shift with immune down-shift; PBRM1/VHL-enriched, BAP1-depleted driver profile), but identity alone does not establish independent membership. Evidence bearing directly on membership is weak: set-level alignment shows near-zero silhouettes and near-identical within/between distances across CT, RNA, WSI, and WXS, and the pair boundary with K5_C0002 is essentially unexpressed (boundary silhouette ~0.0004; between-set affinity 0.00904 only marginally below within-set 0.00946). The union with K5_C0002 is single-cluster dominated, so no internal subdivision is warranted. With membership independence unsupported and no justified structural revision, K5_C0001 is not retained as an independent unit in this run.

K5_C0002 has an interpretable biological identity (OXPHOS up-shift; VHL/PBRM1-depleted driver profile), but identity does not establish independent membership. Set-level alignment is weak and modality-dependent (only WXS shows a modest silhouette of 0.173; CT 0.047, WSI 0.027, RNA 0.008), and the boundary with K5_C0001 is essentially unexpressed (boundary silhouette ~0.0004; between-set affinity 0.00904 vs within-set 0.00946). The union with K5_C0001 is single-cluster dominated, so no internal subdivision is warranted. With membership independence unsupported and no justified structural revision, K5_C0002 is not retained as an independent unit in this run.

K5_C0003 has an interpretable biological identity (immune/inflammatory up-shift with metabolic down-shift), but identity does not establish independent membership. Set-level alignment is only modestly positive across modalities (WSI 0.117, CT 0.066, RNA 0.063, WXS 0.052), and the boundary with K5_C0005 is essentially unexpressed (boundary silhouette ~0.0007; between-set affinity 0.00922 vs within-set 0.00984). The union with K5_C0005 is single-cluster dominated, so no internal subdivision is warranted. With membership independence unsupported and no justified structural revision, K5_C0003 is not retained as an independent unit in this run.

K5_C0004 has an interpretable biological identity (EMT/stromal up-shift with OXPHOS down-shift), but identity does not establish independent membership. Set-level alignment is essentially absent: silhouettes are near zero or negative (CT -0.032, WSI -0.006, RNA 0.001; only WXS 0.073), and within-set versus between-set mean distances are nearly indistinguishable, with CT, WSI, and WXS even showing smaller between distances. No decision-relevant structural revision is supported. With membership independence unsupported, K5_C0004 is not retained as an independent unit in this run.

K5_C0005 has an interpretable biological identity (proliferative up-shift with immune down-shift), but identity does not establish independent membership. Set-level alignment is modality-dependent and unstable: only WSI shows a clear distinction (silhouette 0.268), while CT and RNA are null and WXS is slightly negative, and the set has only 4 members. The boundary with K5_C0003 is essentially unexpressed (boundary silhouette ~0.0007; between-set affinity 0.00922 vs within-set 0.00984), and the union is single-cluster dominated, so no internal subdivision is warranted. With membership independence unsupported and no justified structural revision, K5_C0005 is not retained as an independent unit in this run.
